title: Supplemental Allowance Schedule, Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
Homeowner Service Contracts carry six supplemental allowances. The limit for each, by tier, is below (US dollars; 0.00 means the tier pays nothing for that allowance type).

| | ApplianceCare | SystemsCare | HomeCare Bronze | HomeCare Silver | HomeCare Gold | HomeCare Platinum |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Code violation (per request) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 |
| Permit fees (per request) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 100.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 |
| Haul-away of replaced equipment (per request) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 75.00 | 100.00 | 150.00 |
| Refrigerant recovery and recharge (per term) | 0.00 | 100.00 | 100.00 | 150.00 | 250.00 | 750.00 |
| Crane or lift access (per request) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 |
| Slab leak access (per request) | 0.00 | 500.00 | 0.00 | 500.00 | 750.00 | 1000.00 |

**What each allowance pays toward**

- *Code violation* — the per-request amount paid to correct a code violation discovered during a covered repair or replacement.
- *Permit fees* — the per-request amount paid toward permits required for a covered repair or replacement.
- *Haul-away* — the per-request amount paid to remove and dispose of replaced equipment.
- *Refrigerant* — the per-term amount paid for refrigerant recovery and recharge on covered cooling repairs.
- *Crane or lift access* — the per-request amount paid for crane or lift access to rooftop equipment.
- *Slab leak access* — the per-request amount paid to access a covered leak through a concrete slab and close the opening.

**Observations on the table**

- Bridgewell ApplianceCare shows 0.00 on every allowance.
- The refrigerant line is the only per-term figure in the schedule; the five others are per request.
- Bridgewell HomeCare Gold and Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum are the only tiers with a positive code violation or crane access figure.
